anvisaExemptionReason.description: Enter the number of the decision exempting the medicine from registration at Anvisa,such as, for example, the number of the Resolution of the Anvisa Collegiate Board.

anvisaRecordValidityDate.description: Specify the validity date of the registration with Anvisa.

anvisaRegistrationNumber.description: Specify the record number in ANVISA.Through this number, the system may create the link with the website and consult the medicine.

batchStock.description: Check if this material will have stock separated for each batch. If specified, notransfers for this material can be made without the batch label. We do not recommend use withoutconsulting our support or a Philips consultant first.

code.description: Sequence number, information automatically generated by the system.

consigned.description: Select the type of consignment material for the material in this establishment: 'T'(Temporary/Transitory: consigned material for which there is no stock from the supplier in the hospital and isreceived whenever requested); 'P' (Permanent: consigned material for which there is a stock from the supplierin the hospital and communicates to the supplier via Purchase Order at the time of consumption to receive aninvoice and stock replenishment); A (Both: consigned material that admits both situations in the hospital).

consumptionMonth.description: Generated by the system with the number of months used for the calculation of the monthly consumption.

consumptionStandardDeviation.description: Information automatically generated by the system with the standard deviation ofmaterial consumption, calculated at the time of calculating the order point based on stock consumptionoperations and number of months informed in the purchase parameters.

consumptionUnitPrescription.description: Check if the prescription of this medicine is allowed in the unit of consumption.

consumptionUpdateDateTime.description: Generated by the system with the update time of the monthly consumption and order point.

controlsSeries.description: Specify whether the material is controlled by the serial number.

costClassificationType.description: Select a cost classification for the material or medication. Used to identify in advancehigh cost items that can be denied by the insurance.

curveXYZClassification.description: Specify the XYZ classification of the material.

dayMinimumStock.description: Specify the minimum number of days to stock the material.

dayResupplyInterval.description: Specify the purchasing frequency in days. Standard period for purchase of the item.

daySupplierResupply.description: Specify the number of days for resupply by the supplier. This time period is from theday of the request up to the delivery by the supplier, including the administrative process. Consider theperiod in days, between the material request and the delivery by the supplier.

exemptAnvisaRegistration.description: Check in case of medication exempt from registration at Anvisa.

externalCode.description: Specify the code of the material or medicine in the previous system.

lastUpdate.description: Update date, information automatically generated by the system.

lastUpdateBy.description: User name, information automatically generated by the system.

maximunStockQuantity.description: Information automatically generated by the system in the resupply calculation with themaximum stock quantity of the material for the establishment.

minimumQuotesQuantity.description: Specify the minimum number of quotations required for the purchase.

minimunStockQuantity.description: Information automatically generated by the system when calculating the resupply.In order to obey the fixed value specified, the supplier days field, minimum stock field and intervaldays field must have a value of zero.

monthlyConsumptionQuantity.description: Information automatically generated by the system with the monthly consumption.It is calculated based on the stock consumption operations and the number of months informed in thepurchasing parameters. It is calculated when calculating the request point in the valuation. It takes intoconsideration the consumption transfers and ignores if it is negative. It can be consulted in the function'Material Record', tab 'Consultation/consumption', or in the report of monthly consumption per cost center.

patientStockSettlement.description: Check if the system should settle stock when supplied to the patient.

prescription.description: Specify whether the material may be ordered.

purchaseStockConversion.description: Enter the quantity contained in a purchasing unit regarding the stock unit.

requestPoint.description: Information automatically generated when calculating the order point. Minimum stock + (Dailyconsumption * supplier days). In order to obey the fixed value specified, the supplier day field, minimumstock day field and interval day field must have a value of zero.

requisition.description: Specify whether the material may be requested.

resupply.description: Specify whether the system must generate a resupply for this establishment.To generate the resupply, the system will still define whether the material is active, if it is astock controller and if it exists in the stock balance.

standardized.description: Specify whether the material is or is not standardized for use in the medical order.

stockConsumptionConversion.description: Specify the quantity contained in a stock unit regarding the consumption unit.

stockMaterial.description: Specify whether the system must control the material stock for this establishment.

validAnvisa.description: Specify whether the product is valid with Anvisa, regardless of the Anvisa validity date.When this field is marked, the system will not consider the date of validity. This field serves to meet RDCNo. 40, chapter V, from Anvisa. There is also the rule in 'Core Tables Settings > Main Application > Stockrecords > Anvisa requirements for the material', to define that this field must be marked each time aproduct is registered or has its registration changed.
